shortage.title: Shortage Report
shortage.description: Scans every order in the selected statuses and reads its admin note ("یادداشت مدیر") for a shortage signal: a note with no item reference counts the whole order as short, otherwise the referenced item row(s) are resolved from the note.
shortage.liveApiRequired: This report requires the Live API data source (see Settings) -- imported order data has no admin note field or Shopfa status codes.
shortage.loading: Scanning orders and admin notes… this can take a moment.
shortage.wholeOrderShortage: {{count}} order with no item reference (counted whole)
shortage.wholeOrderShortage_other: {{count}} orders with no item reference (counted whole)
shortage.unresolvedNotes: {{count}} note could not be resolved to an item (click to view)
shortage.unresolvedNotes_other: {{count}} notes could not be resolved to an item (click to view)
shortage.noShortages: No shortages found for the selected statuses.
shortage.unresolvedDialogTitle: Notes that could not be resolved to an item
shortage.unresolvedDialogDescription: These orders' admin notes mention "مورد"/"موارد" but couldn't be matched to a specific item row (e.g. an "all except N" phrasing) -- review them manually.

common.invalidRange: Choose a start date on or before the end date, at most one year apart

customer.title: Customer Report
customer.description: Find a customer by name or mobile number and see their orders and spending within a period. Only orders with a completed-sale status count toward the totals; other orders (cancelled, unfinished checkout, …) are listed dimmed.
customer.liveApiRequired: This report requires the Live API data source (see Settings).
customer.searchHelper: At least {{count}} characters. A name may match several customers.
customer.truncated: This search matched too many orders, so the result may be incomplete. Use a more specific name or mobile number, or a shorter period.
customer.noResults: No orders found for this customer in the selected period.

itemSales.title: Item Sales Report
itemSales.description: How many units of one product, or of a whole category such as earrings or necklaces, were sold in a period. Counts only completed-sale orders, dated by payment date.
itemSales.liveApiRequired: This report requires the Live API data source (see Settings).
itemSales.typeToSearch: Type a product name to search
itemSales.loading: Scanning orders… this can take up to a minute for long periods.
itemSales.noSales: Nothing was sold in this period.

categoryTrends.title: Category Sales Trends
categoryTrends.description: Units or revenue sold per product category over time, in equal steps ending today. Counts only completed-sale orders, dated by payment date. The first load of a window can take up to a minute; repeat views are cached for 10 minutes.
categoryTrends.liveApiRequired: This report requires the Live API data source (see Settings).
categoryTrends.stepNote: Each column covers {{step}} days; the last column includes today.
categoryTrends.noSales: Nothing was sold in this window.
